scripts.dev: npm run build -w @watchparty/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @watchparty/server" "npm run dev -w @watchparty/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @watchparty/shared && npm run build -w @watchparty/server && npm run build -w @watchparty/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @watchparty/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
